payload.hypothesis: A meta-learner combining market, Deadeye, Elo, and a scoring model will improve ACQL credited-game probability over Deadeye on chronologically held-out seasons.
payload.objective: Improve held-out log loss for the chance that the home side is credited under ACQL pool rules; keep pool picks and money separate from probability quality.

preregistration.protocol: strategy-lab-1; archived retrospective holdout, not the current prospective-lock protocol
preregistration.primary_metric: log-loss improvement versus Deadeye; positive means the candidate has lower log loss
preregistration.success_criteria: Beat Deadeye on development and holdout under the preregistered protocol and pass its leak/data gates; no promotion from development-only performance.
